name: Spherical Harmonics Encoder
definition: A neural network module that encodes a 3D direction vector into spherical harmonics coefficients up to a specified degree. It solves the problem of representing directional information (view direction) in a differentiable, basis-function expansion for view-dependent rendering.
summary: The Spherical Harmonics Encoder is a neural network module that converts 3D direction vectors into differentiable spherical harmonics coefficients for view-dependent rendering.
